review.delivery: Actual PNG pixels were delivered through functions.view_image and image() in this chat. After final recapture, all six full-page PNGs were delivered again. The other 30 required PNGs are byte-identical to the previously delivered, substantively reviewed image inputs; this is reuse of an actual pixel review, not a review inferred from hashes.
review.judgment: The complete story and explored full-page flow keep all 15 scenes. The repaired stacked evidence page uses a plot plus side note and breaks the repeated six-chart composition. Cream paper, serif headings and coral/blue data remain readable. Native code, filtered chart, selected second crop and expanded hotspot were inspected: original code, gap marker, image detail, source labels and selection emphasis remain visible. Full-page views were downscaled by the image viewer and were used for order/rhythm; native component captures establish text/detail legibility. review.delivery: Actual PNG pixels were delivered through functions.view_image and image() in this chat. After final recapture, all six full-page PNGs were delivered again. The other 30 required PNGs are byte-identical to the previously delivered, substantively reviewed image inputs; this is reuse of an actual pixel review, not a review inferred from hashes.
review.judgment: The complete story and explored full-page flow keep all 15 scenes. The repaired stacked evidence page uses a plot plus side note and breaks the repeated six-chart composition. Dark backgrounds keep light labels, lime/purple series and readable active controls. Native code, filtered chart, selected second crop and expanded hotspot were inspected: original code, gap marker, image detail, source labels and selection emphasis remain visible. Full-page views were downscaled by the image viewer and were used for order/rhythm; native component captures establish text/detail legibility. review.delivery: Actual PNG pixels were delivered through functions.view_image and image() in this chat. After final recapture, all six full-page PNGs were delivered again. The other 30 required PNGs are byte-identical to the previously delivered, substantively reviewed image inputs; this is reuse of an actual pixel review, not a review inferred from hashes.
review.judgment: The complete story and explored full-page flow keep all 15 scenes. The repaired stacked evidence page uses a plot plus side note and breaks the repeated six-chart composition. White evidence surfaces, violet accents and the saturated chapter retain a consistent hierarchy. Native code, filtered chart, selected second crop and expanded hotspot were inspected: original code, gap marker, image detail, source labels and selection emphasis remain visible. Full-page views were downscaled by the image viewer and were used for order/rhythm; native component captures establish text/detail legibility. review.judgment: The complete story and explored full-page flow keep all 15 scenes. The repaired stacked evidence page uses a plot plus side note and breaks the repeated six-chart composition. Cream paper, serif headings and coral/blue data remain readable. Native code, filtered chart, selected second crop and expanded hotspot were inspected: original code, gap marker, image detail, source labels and selection emphasis remain visible. Full-page views were downscaled by the image viewer and were used for order/rhythm; native component captures establish text/detail legibility. This review covers the recorded representative images, not every native scene or possible state. Non-blocking missing-marker spacing remains recorded.

issues.reason: In the filtered view, the missing-value label sits close to the zero-axis tick. The label still states Missing/缺失 and full original data remains available.
issues.suggestion: In a future scoped chart-label adjustment, separate the missing marker from the zero tick without replacing null with zero.

review.delivery: Actual PNG pixels were delivered through functions.view_image and image() in this chat. After final recapture, all six full-page PNGs were delivered again. The other 30 required PNGs are byte-identical to the previously delivered, substantively reviewed image inputs; this is reuse of an actual pixel review, not a review inferred from hashes.
review.judgment: The complete story and explored full-page flow keep all 15 scenes. The repaired stacked evidence page uses a plot plus side note and breaks the repeated six-chart composition. Dark backgrounds keep light labels, lime/purple series and readable active controls. Native code, filtered chart, selected second crop and expanded hotspot were inspected: original code, gap marker, image detail, source labels and selection emphasis remain visible. Full-page views were downscaled by the image viewer and were used for order/rhythm; native component captures establish text/detail legibility. This review covers the recorded representative images, not every native scene or possible state. Non-blocking missing-marker spacing remains recorded.

issues.reason: In the filtered view, the missing-value label sits close to the zero-axis tick. The label still states Missing/缺失 and full original data remains available.
issues.suggestion: In a future scoped chart-label adjustment, separate the missing marker from the zero tick without replacing null with zero.

The other 30 required PNGs are byte-identical to the previously delivered, substantively reviewed image inputs; this is reuse of an actual pixel review, not a review inferred from hashes.
review.judgment: The complete story and explored full-page flow keep all 15 scenes. The repaired stacked evidence page uses a plot plus side note and breaks the repeated six-chart composition. White evidence surfaces, violet accents and the saturated chapter retain a consistent hierarchy. Native code, filtered chart, selected second crop and expanded hotspot were inspected: original code, gap marker, image detail, source labels and selection emphasis remain visible. Full-page views were downscaled by the image viewer and were used for order/rhythm; native component captures establish text/detail legibility. This review covers the recorded representative images, not every native scene or possible state. Non-blocking missing-marker spacing remains recorded.
